in_marathi.name: Madhurima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhurima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhurima is derived from the Sanskrit word 'madhura' which means sweet. The 'rima' suffix is derived from the word 'rima' meaning 'rhythm' or 'rime'. Thus, Madhurima can be translated as 'Sweet Rime'.
